messages:
maria: Heads-up — Riptide LoRA merge on int4 q4f16 landed on staging and quick eval pack shows a subtle token shift on currency amounts. attaching summary.

akash: Looking... any repro prompt?

maria: Short repro:
```text
Customer invoice: "Total due: $7,345.00"
```
Model response truncates/misreports amounts: "Total due: $0.00" in ~10% of cases on staging.

noah: sounds like tokenizer mapping / quantization bias. Did we run rr-tokenmap-v2? Was the LoRA merged with bias correction?

maria: We ran tokenmap for base but LoRA was patched via lora-merge-v1 (no bias-correct). Quick eval pack summary (eval-bot): 120 prompts, 12 failures -> top classes: numeric-shift (7), rounding-collapse (3), hallucination (2).

ci-bot: ran eval-pack/riptide-quick-20231114 -> 120 prompts, 12 fails. logs: https://ci/runs/12340

eva: can we try merging with --bias-correct and forcing per-channel quant stats? Also try int8 as a control.

akash: spinning two jobs now:
1) merge+bias-correct int4 (run/12345)
2) merge int4 + kv-cache-reset (run/12346)
ETA ~20m.

maria: checklist:
- reproduce locally
- run tokenmap+remap
- merge with --bias-correct
- run quickpack
- escalate if failures persist

noah: capture quant config: qconfig=q4f16, zero_point=8, per_channel=true, clip=0.02. Seed=42.

ci-bot: job links:
- https://ci/runs/12345
- https://ci/runs/12346

akash: results:
- run/12345 (bias-correct): 120/120 pass for numeric stability.
- run/12346 (kv-reset): 118/120, failures reduced, cases still reproduce under specific high-digit locales.

maria: excellent. plan: promote bias-corrected merge to staging, rerun expanded eval (200 prompts, varied locales), add non-regression test to onboarding harness.

eva: adding test in onboarding/tests/riptide_numeric.json, threshold numeric_exact >= 0.99.

maria: I'll open PR with merge script flag and updated test. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

akash: nice catch. tagging @noah for post-merge watchlist.

noah: will monitor and keep an eye on telemetry for a day.
